attribution.note: Marcus endorses the characterization of institutional enthusiasm; the AGI hope is attributed to those institutions.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the qualified impression and attributes the AGI expectation to others. It is not Marcus's own forecast.

contract.note: The contract fairly recognizes that a binary test would require added definitions of institutional scope and enthusiasm. The firm-language plain-reading exception does not apply.

evidence.note: A contemporaneous official government statement of AI ambitions. It provides context for enthusiasm but does not establish an LLM-to-AGI belief. The source-type label's limitation is disclosed.
Google's contemporaneous disclosure connects Gemini to AGI ambitions. It contextualizes the impression but cannot establish a collective Silicon Valley attitude or an objective enthusiasm threshold.

reviews.rationale: The statement offers a qualified, figurative impression without a determinate threshold. The evidence supplies relevant context, but scoring the impression would add commitments Marcus did not make. This is not a broken case.
